component.name: Horizon Drive
component.summary: Premium Google Drive desktop client for Linux

description.p: Horizon Drive is a native Google Drive desktop client for Linux with a polished Fluent-style dark UI. It offers two-way background sync, a live transfer queue, storage quota display, and smart views (Recent, Starred, Trash, Shared with me).
Credentials are stored exclusively in the system keyring — never in plain-text files. Users bring their own Google Cloud API credentials (BYOK) for privacy and speed.
Production polish: system tray with live status icons, real-time transfer queue, live storage quota.
